en: A black‑and‑white coastal view of a Scandinavian seaside village with wooden houses scattered on rocky terrain by the water. A narrow road winds out along a low peninsula lined with compact wooden homes. The landscape is rugged with bare rocks and low vegetation, and more buildings are visible on distant shores across the bay. In the lower left corner the word "HÄLSÖ." is printed, and in the lower right corner there is a triangular publisher's logo above the number 5330, consistent with vintage picture postcards.
